scope: T02 stale-async-completion fixes + deferred-promise behavior regressions (injected verifyMessage/clock/wallet/resolver seams, synthetic signatures). Zero network/wallet/transaction.

defects_fixed.root_cause: verifyChallenge captured the challenge but never re-checked currency after the SDK await, so a candidate/account/disconnect invalidation during the await still published VERIFIED
defects_fixed.fix: added a monotonic verificationGeneration (bumped by invalidateSignedState on candidate/account/disconnect switch); verifyChallenge re-reads generation + lastChallenge identity after the await and returns a detached STALE_OPERATION without touching status
defects_fixed.regression: HARNESS-CANDIDATE-SWITCH-STALE -> ok:false STALE_OPERATION; newer status/lastResult untouched

defects_fixed.root_cause: freshness was only checked BEFORE the await; the clock could advance past expiry while the verifier was pending
defects_fixed.fix: verifyChallenge re-checks nowMs() >= expiresAtMs (and issuedAtMs > now) AFTER the await before publishing success

additional_guards: invalidateSignedState() now bumps verificationGeneration and is called at the START of disconnectWallet (before its await)
late sign callbacks: signChallenge re-checks generation after the wallet.signMessage await; a boundary crossed while signing returns STALE_OPERATION and does not (re)populate lastChallenge
wallet:signOut success:false no longer records a SIGNED_OUT boundary nor invalidates; only success:true records a boundary and invalidates
stale completions return a detached result (never overwrite status/lastResult of the newer session)

nonce overlap lock ownership: a stale (generation-mismatched) completion neither deletes nor consumes the nonce; invalidateSignedState already cleared verifyingNonces, so a new attempt's reservation is untouched

regression_results.verify:t02-adversarial: 18/18 PASS (11 prior + 7 new async: candidate switch, expiry-during-verify, disconnect-immediate, disconnect-completes, late-sign, failed-signout-not-relogin, success-signout-relogin)

clean_clone_notice: the harness and wallet-adapter import only near-api-js, @hot-labs/near-connect and the accepted packages/domain internal modules; no import/dependency on the unaccepted packages/intents-adapter, no viem/privy-sdk/Monad/config/secrets carryover.
limits: W03/G02/G03 and any live NEAR Connect / NEAR Auth signature remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL (need human + real wallet); not claimed live.
consumedNonces/verifyingNonces/verificationGeneration are in-memory per page load (probe scope); production must persist nonce consumption + generation atomically.
no commit/push, no deployment, no financial action.
